name: arve-root
description: ARVE - AI Security Pattern & Attack Intelligence

scripts.dev:frontend: infisical run --env=dev --path=/frontend -- npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:backend: infisical run --env=dev --path=/backend -- python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir backend
scripts.dev:worker: infisical run --env=dev --path=/backend -- celery -A app.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --pool=solo --workdir backend
scripts.test: npm run build --prefix frontend && python -m pytest backend/tests
